state_shape.request: preprocessTinyMessage(prompt), or prompt cut to 10,000 characters when restated is true

semantics.prompt: User words in a Matt run: the text after User: on a skill start, or a later prompt. No skill body is included.
semantics.expected: A required Addon pick. The check flags mean P(yes) < 0.65; the runtime selects at 0.70.
semantics.allowed: A pick is acceptable either way; it is not an unexpected pick.
semantics.other: An Addon outside expected and allowed is flagged when mean P(yes) > 0.95.
semantics.baseline_selected: Mean P(yes) over 3 fresh direct POST runs with the catalog and the state shape above (2026-10-24), >= 0.70. Stored values round to 3 decimals.
semantics.baseline_borderline: Mean P(yes) in [0.65, 0.95], including scores that are also selected. Stored values round to 3 decimals.
semantics.restated: The prompt is a stored smol restatement, written once with the extension's in-your-own-words instruction and frame. A restated-<name> sample restates a synthetic mid-session talk (ADR 0021). A fresh-<id> sample restates only the words of the plain sample <id>, as a fresh run start does, and keeps that sample's expected and allowed lists unchanged (ADR 0026). The check sends the prompt as it is, cut to 10,000 characters.
